Which of the following is a first-order linear ordinary differential equation?

a
dydx+xln⁡(xy)=x2
b
dydx−exy=x
c
(dydx)2−x3=1+y

1y2dydx−x2=sin⁡x

dydx−exxy=x2sin⁡x
